تقتعدي (form VIII)
# تَقْتَعِدِي (taqtaʕidī) /taq.ta.ʕi.diː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
# تُقْتَعَدِي (tuqtaʕadī) /tuq.ta.ʕa.diː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
